inputs.label: Ninja Assault NAOMI sets
inputs.help: Your own NAOMI World NJA2 Ver.A sets ninjaslt.zip and naomi.zip. Leave them zipped. No CHD is needed.

steps.why: The game reads the sets from Download. The guide has the user grant storage access.

steps.text: Open Ninja Assault VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for storage access, allow it. Wait while it prepares the guns the first time.

notes: Releases also carry a PCVR zip and a source zip. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
